post.description: Answers a question WITHOUT any session state: no working-memory hydration, no conversation persistence, no consolidation outbox. It first consults a per-(tenant,user) response cache; on a hit the stored answer is returned WITHOUT an LLM call. On a miss it builds context from tenant-scoped semantic retrieval (RAG), makes one LLM call, runs the output guardrail, caches the answer under the (tenant,user) scope, and returns it. The cache is scoped so a cross-tenant hit is impossible by construction (see internal/responsecache).

It re-encodes the SAME streaming pipeline the /chat/stream endpoint runs (StreamCore): identity->ctx isolation, quota gate, input/output guardrails, tenant-scoped hydration and cost accounting all apply unchanged — only the wire format differs.

post.description: Streams the LLM response token by token, hydrating the system prompt from the session's working memory (summary + recent messages) and persisting both the user and assistant turns once the stream completes successfully. Uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if set; otherwise falls back to the canned stub (internal/llm) so the SSE path can be verified without credentials. Honors ctx cancellation: if the client cuts the connection, the stream stops immediately and no partial assistant turn is persisted.
